name: Mix Fold 3

images.credit: メイド理世, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Body.Other: Side-mounted fingerprint sensor, aluminum frame, aramid fiber or glass back, barometer

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 13 with MIUI Fold 14, Current: Android 15 with Xiaomi HyperOS 2
Platform.CPU: Octa-core (1x3.36 GHz Cortex-X3 & 2x2.8 GHz Cortex-A715 & 2x2.8 GHz Cortex-A710 & 3x2.0 GHz Cortex-A510)

Display.Display: Main: 8.03 in Foldable LTPO OLED+, 1B colors, 120Hz, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, 1300 nits (peak), 1916×2160 px (~360 ppi), Cover: 6.56 in AMOLED, 120Hz, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, 2600 nits (peak), 1080×2520 px (21:9), Gorilla Glass Victus 2

Cameras.Rear camera: 50 MP, 1.8, 23 mm (wide), 1/1.49", 1.0μm, PDAF, OIS, 10 MP, 2.0, 75 mm (3.2x telephoto), OIS, 10 MP, 2.9, 115 mm (5x periscope telephoto), OIS, 12 MP, 2.2, 15 mm (ultrawide), 120˚ FOVLeica optics, LED flash, HDR, panorama, color spectrum sensor, Video: 8K@24fps, 4K@24/30/60fps, 1080p@30/60/120/240/960/1920fps, Dolby Vision HDR

Sound.Sound: Stereo speakers, 24-bit/192kHz Hi-Res & Hi-Res wireless audio, Tuned by Harman Kardon

Battery.Charging: 67W wired, 100% in 40 min (PD3.0, QC4), 50W wireless, 100% in 55 min

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/6e/7 (tri-band capable), Bluetooth 5.3 (A2DP, LE), NFC, Infrared port, USB-C 3.2 OTG, GPS, GLONASS, BDS, Galileo, QZSS, NavIC
